title: Thai Stir-Fry Recipe
description: A quick and easy Thai stir-fry recipe made with your choice of protein and vegetables, served over a bed of steamed rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the snow peas and cook until they are tender-crisp, about 2 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over cooked rice.
Sprinkle with Mediterranean seasoning to taste.
